/slur for Windsurf

slur generator for Windsurf

Install a local insult and slur generator as a Windsurf workflow and custom slash command. Every standalone /slur token produces a random one-to-five-term combination.

how it works

The workflow runs the local Slur binary once and treats its output as the replacement request.

adapter
Windsurf global workflow
runtime
local Rust binary
default Unix path
~/.codeium/windsurf/global_workflows/slur.md
invoke
/slur
network
none while generating

install

  1. macOS / Linux
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darhebkf/slur/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- windsurf
  2. Windows PowerShell
    irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darhebkf/slur/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
    slur setup windsurf
  3. reload

    Restart Windsurf after setup so it discovers the global workflow.

use /slur

You /slur your work needs another pass, you /slur.

Each token expands independently. Use slur block "word" to hide a term, slur add "phrase" to add one, and slur off to disable output.

questions

Is /slur a cloud service?
No. Generation and filtering happen on your machine.
Does it send prompts or telemetry?
No. The generator makes no network requests while producing text.
Can I block words?
Yes. The block list is local, case-insensitive, and editable from the CLI.
